walkthrough.title: Get started with iPreview
walkthrough.description: Notion-style Markdown editing — Live / Raw toggle, slash menu, shortcuts
walkthrough.toggle.title: Switch between Live and Raw
walkthrough.toggle.description:
Move between Live (edit with formatting shown, like Obsidian) and Raw (the plain Markdown source).
[Toggle Live / Raw](command:markdownInline.toggleLive)
walkthrough.slash.title: Insert with the slash menu
walkthrough.slash.description: Type / at the start of a line to quickly insert headings, lists, tables, and more.
walkthrough.shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
walkthrough.shortcuts.description: Learn the shortcuts for headings, checkboxes, and formatting to speed things up.
config.live.showLineNumbers: Show line numbers in Live mode
config.live.showDiffGutter: Show the diff against Git HEAD in the left gutter in Live mode
config.live.showToolbar: Show the toolbar at the top in Live mode
config.live.enableSlashMenu: Enable slash commands (/) in Live mode
config.live.defaultMode: Default mode when opening Markdown (raw = plain text editing, live = Obsidian-style live editing)
config.live.rememberMode: Remember the mode last used for each file and reopen it in that mode
config.live.controlDefaultEditor: Keep the default editor for .md (workbench.editorAssociations) in sync with the current mode, so files open directly in the right editor
config.live.avoidPanelGroup: When Markdown opens in an editor group that only holds panels (Claude, terminals), move it to the group that holds documents
config.live.alwaysOpenNewTab: Always open files in a new tab (disable VS Code preview tab reuse)
config.live.wordWrap: Wrap Markdown by default (sets editor.wordWrap for the [markdown] scope)
config.live.wrapTabs: Wrap the tab bar onto multiple rows when there are many tabs (workbench.editor.wrapTabs)
config.enablePreview: Enable Markdown decorations (headings, checkboxes, and so on)
config.notionKeymap.enabled: Enable Notion-compatible keybindings (⌘B bold, ⌘E code, ⌘K link, ⌥⌘digits block conversion). Turning it off restores the VS Code defaults
command.openLive: Markdown Inline Preview: Open in Live mode
command.openRaw: Markdown Inline Preview: Open in Raw mode
command.smartMoveLeft: Smart Move Left (Move cursor after Markdown element)
command.smartSelectLeft: Smart Select Left (Select from element to end of line)
command.smartMoveRight: Smart Move Right (Move cursor in table cells)
command.smartSelectAll: Smart Select All in Table Cell or Code Block
command.exportPdf: Markdown Inline Preview: Export to PDF
command.exportMarp: Markdown Inline Preview: Export as Slides (Marp PDF)
command.exportDocx: Markdown Inline Preview: Export to Word (.docx)
command.batchExport: Markdown Inline Preview: Batch Export to PDF…
